concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (F1 score must be ≤10 % lower than Raw‑History baseline and ≥10 % higher than Null‑History baseline) is not explicitly enforced by any task; existing tasks T008 and T010 compute F1 scores but never assert the required relative performance thresholds.

Success Criterion SC-005 requires reporting the standard deviation of per‑task mean F1 scores and seed‑level variance for reproducibility, yet no task computes or records these statistics; tasks T005‑T007 run three seeds but only log latency and predictions, and T008 only verifies score ranges.

Constitution Principle III mandates that every file under `data/` be checksummed and recorded in the project state YAML, but the task list contains no task that generates or updates these checksums after data transformations.
